paragraphs: R' Yochanan, the brother of Rav Safra.
He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Chagigah, chapter 1, halakhah 6, where he objected to the words of R' Yose (the colleague of R' Yonah).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied חגיגה is Chagigah, unlike historical machine חניגה; פ״א ה״ו explicitly gives chapter 1 halakhah 6 in Jerusalem Talmud, without independently checked passage.

The headed Yochanan is the natural implicit subject of objected; the colleague parenthesis naturally identifies Yose. This grammatical reading is not identity admission. Safra’s full רב remains Rav, while the three ר׳ titles remain R'.
